provenance.sanitized: Author email, tap intents and any font payload references were removed. Layer geometry, formulas and CLEAR paint modes are retained. The source defines side, fg and primary globals but no bg or h global.

missing_global_adaptation.bg: The source has no bg global and no filled dial card. The clip shape is used only as an outer mask; no background fill is invented.
missing_global_adaptation.h: The Clip and CLEAR ShapeModules reference an undefined h global. This port normalises the host to the 277 square design viewport used by the other Nothing analog ports and uses each CLEAR width as its square height. This is a documented port choice, not proof of the missing source height.
missing_global_adaptation.scale: config_scale_value 157.74908 is recorded from the actual source but the native 277 vector viewport is used instead of applying the Kustom scale at runtime.
missing_global_adaptation.contrast: The source fg follows the wallpaper (darkwp). RemoteViews cannot safely sample the wallpaper, so this port applies a manual wallpaper-contrast override per Dotwel style: BLACK and TRANSPARENT use white ticks/minute hand, TRANSLUCENT uses dark #1B1B1D ticks/minute hand. All three styles keep a transparent dial card.
missing_global_adaptation.clear: The two CLEAR ShapeModules are real transparent cut-outs in the generated vectors. The combined vector uses android:fillType=evenOdd so the CLEAR rounded rectangles are holes in the static tick polygons, not an opaque background fill.
